What is Liberty's probability of making the Conference USA Championship Game?

Liberty has a 29.8% chance to reach the Conference USA Championship Game, as of week 1 of the 2026 season, based on a 100,000-season Monte Carlo simulation. Liberty's Conference USA Championship Game race is still mathematically wide open.
